description: Maintained caption + attribution layer. Every record is captioned and attributed. Sources, in priority order: SGPHS timeline figcaptions (caption + credit), provenance embedded in original collection filenames, and descriptive captions written from filename text and the researched date. Attribution is 'Unknown' only when no holder or creator can be established. Re-applied every pipeline run by apply_editorial_captions.

attribution_confidence_levels.confirmed: explicit published credit line (e.g. SGPHS timeline figcaption)
attribution_confidence_levels.high: named collection/institution/newspaper recorded in the source filename
attribution_confidence_levels.medium: aggregator platform named (e.g. Calisphere) but contributing institution not yet resolved
attribution_confidence_levels.low: weak provenance hint (e.g. eBay listing) — holder not established
attribution_confidence_levels.unknown: no holder or creator identifiable from any available source
